title: Synd
summary: A web-based synthetic data generation tool with a Django backend that trains a CTGAN model on tabular data and produces a quality report for the generated output; it uses SDV's SingleTableMetadata and evaluate_quality functions directly to score the synthetic data against the real data.
evidence: backend/data_generation/views.py:24-25: from sdv.metadata import SingleTableMetadata; from sdv.evaluation.single_table import evaluate_quality
needs: CTGAN is used via standalone package, not sdv.single_table; evaluate_quality/SingleTableMetadata confirm direct sdv API use for reporting.
